name: Bulk Product Price Update for Woocommerce
author: Knovator

sections.description:
The Bulk Product Price Update for WooCommerce plugin empowers you to efficiently update product prices within minutes. Whether you’re adjusting regular prices or sale prices, this tool streamlines the process for all products within selected categories.

Key Features:

Category Selection:
Easily select the categories of products you want to update from the dropdown menu.

Percentage Adjustment:
Apply price changes swiftly by inputting the desired percentage value.

Rounding Options:
Choose whether to round up your results or retain decimal precision for the updated prices.

Increase or Decrease Actions:
Flexibly adjust prices by selecting whether to increase or decrease them based on your requirements.

Variable Product Support (Premium):
Bulk-update prices on variable product variations, not just simple products. Requires a Premium license.

Licensing

This plugin has a Free and a Premium plan. Premium unlocks bulk price updates
for variable product variations. Each Premium license key can be active on
one site at a time — activating it on a new site requires deactivating it
on the previous one first (manage this from Plugins > Bulk Product Price >
Account after entering your license key).

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses Freemius to manage licensing, plan opt-in, and update delivery for the Premium version. On opt-in, the site’s URL and basic, non-personally-identifiable usage data are sent to Freemius’s servers so the plugin can check plan/license status and offer updates. Opting in is optional — you can skip it and still use the Free plan’s features.

Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
Freemius Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1.Go to your plugin browser inside your wordpress installation and search bulk price update by keyword. Then choose “Bulk Product Price Update for Woocommerce” and click install. It will be installed shortly.
2.Activate the plugin from Plugins menu after installation
